scripts.start:concurrently: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow" --prefix "[{name}]" --names "CLIENT,USER-DETAILS,WEB-SCRAPER" "npm run start:client" "npm run start:user-details" "npm run start:web-scraper"
scripts.start:separate-terminals: osascript -e 'tell app "Terminal" to do script "cd `pwd`/client/price-compare-client && npm start"' && osascript -e 'tell app "Terminal" to do script "cd `pwd`/services/user-details && export \$(cat .env | grep -v '^#' | grep -v '^$' | xargs) && npx sls offline --config serverless-user-details.yml --stage dev"' && osascript -e 'tell app "Terminal" to do script "cd `pwd`/services/web-scraper && export \$(cat .env | grep -v '^#' | grep -v '^$' | xargs) && npx sls offline --stage dev"'
scripts.start:user-details: cd services/user-details && export $(cat .env | grep -v '^#' | grep -v '^$' | xargs) && npx sls offline --config serverless-user-details.yml --stage dev
scripts.start:web-scraper: cd services/web-scraper && export $(cat .env | grep -v '^#' | grep -v '^$' | xargs) && npx sls offline --stage dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client/price-compare-client && npm install && cd ../../services/user-details && npm install && cd ../web-scraper && npm install
